linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, open this link on your phone:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.intro: Welcome! Please confirm your email address to finish setting up your account.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you didn't create an account, you can ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your account.
resetPassword.expiry: This link expires in 30 minutes and can be used once.
resetPassword.ignore: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.intro: Your password was just changed, and you have been signed out on all devices.
passwordChanged.warning: If this wasn't you, contact the administrator immediately.

accountApproved.subject: Your account has been approved
accountApproved.intro: Good news: an administrator approved your account. You can now sign in to the app.
